headline: Put consistent product guidance and floor planning at the associate’s fingertips.
capabilities: Surface product specs, comparisons, and current promotions instantly
Confirm inventory and suggest alternatives for out-of-stock items
Recommend accessories and warranties with conversion tips
Prepare transactions with loyalty discounts and financing options automatically
outcomes: Increased accessory attach rates and average transaction value
Eliminated pricing errors and improved checkout speed
Enabled associates to serve more customers and boost commission
why_try: It demonstrates how associates can get faster context without creating inventory promises, pressure-based selling, or workforce profiling.

sample_prompts.label: Look up a product safely
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me the product facts, floor location, optional complements, and availability caveat for the running shoes.

sample_prompts.label: Draft customer-assistance language
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft respectful language for acknowledging a complaint while keeping the decision with an authorized reviewer.

sample_prompts.label: Plan the store shift
sample_prompts.prompt: Turn the opening work into a prioritized planning checklist without claiming execution.

sample_prompts.label: Review aggregate coaching signals
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize aggregate role-cohort coaching signals without ranking employees.

business_flow: Store Associate, Floor Specialist, and Sales Manager
Approved commerce catalog and inventory data
